subject: SOC 2 / SIG: Request for ephemeral key compendium & rotation proof
messages:
From: Priya Malhotra <priya.malhotra@audits.example.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightline.com
Date: Tue, 4 Dec 2028 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG - Ephemeral key evidence request

Connor —

Hope you’re well. As part of the upcoming SOC 2 readiness review and our SIG submission we need a concise bundle of items covering ephemeral key management and rotation practices for customer tenant isolation. Specifically we’re asking for the following:

- A compendium (CSV or spreadsheet) listing ephemeral key material lifecycle events (creation timestamp, TTL/expiry, rotation event id, operator id) for the last 12 months.
- The operator ACL export and a short narrative explaining operator separation and dual-control for HSM ceremonies.
- The rotation/playbook that describes the automated rotation and emergency rewrap procedures (runbook excerpt is fine).
- Samples of HSM shift logs or commit records that show rotation timestamps and snapshot hashes.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce these artifacts by 2028-12-11? If you have an internal owner for each item, please include them. If anything is sensitive and needs to be delivered via a restricted transfer, call that out and we’ll set up a secure exchange.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Malhotra
Senior Auditor, Compliance & Risk
Audits Example
[attachment: SOC2-questions-excerpt.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Malhotra <priya.malhotra@audits.example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Dec 2028 16:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG - Ephemeral key evidence request

Priya —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested artifacts. High level plan:

- Ephemeral key compendium: Marissa will prepare a CSV export (creation/expiry/rotation-id/operator-id) for the 12-month window.
- HSM operator ACLs & runbook: Ben will export the operator ACLs and redact any PII; we’ll include the runbook excerpt describing dual-control ceremonies and emergency rewrap.
- HSM shift logs: Irene will pull sampled shiftlog entries and include signed snapshot hashes.

Target ETA: 2028-12-11 (we can accelerate if you need a partial delivery earlier). If any item must be delivered over a secure channel, flag it and we’ll use a presigned SFTP or our secure artifact exchange.

I’ll coordinate the file delivery and share a Drive folder and Jira ticket for traceability.

Connor O'Brien
Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[internal note: assigning SEC-4321 to pull artifacts]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Dec 2028 09:28:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG - Ephemeral key evidence request (artifact plan)

Connor / Ben —

I’ve started the compendium export and it will include the following columns: tenant_id, key_id, created_at (UTC), expiry_at (UTC), rotation_event_id, rotation_type (auto/manual/emergency), operator_id, operator_role, hsm_slot, note. Sample rows anonymized for non-prod tenants are fine; for production tenant rows we will include tenant_id per auditor request.

Attachments planned for initial drop:
- ephemeral-key-manifest.csv (CSV, ~48KB) — contains 12 months of TTL/rotation events (anonymized/pseudonymized where required)
- rotation-playbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB) — runbook excerpt covering scheduled rotation and emergency rewrap flow with decision gates
- hsm-operator-acls-export.json (JSON, 16KB) — operator list + role mapping (will redact contact info)

Irene — can you pull the shiftlog sample (we’ll include 3 signed entries showing rotation commit timestamps and the snapshot hash) and confirm the export format? Ben — can you also generate an ACL explanation paragraph describing separation-of-duty controls? I’ll assemble and ship to Connor for final review by EOD 2028-12-08.

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: planned-artifacts-checklist.txt]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Malhotra <priya.malhotra@audits.example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Dec 2028 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG - Ephemeral key evidence request

Priya —

We delivered the initial bundle to the Drive folder (link below) and attached the files to this message for convenience. Items included: ephemeral-key-manifest.csv, rotation-playbook_v2.pdf, hsm-operator-acls-export.json, and three sampled shiftlog entries (redacted where required).

Delivery notes:
- ephemeral-key-manifest.csv: lists creation/expiry/rotation_event_id/operator_role for 12 months; production tenant IDs included per your request.
- rotation-playbook_v2.pdf: includes a short decision flow for automatic rotation, conditions for emergency rewrap, and rollback criteria.
- hsm-operator-acls-export.json: role mapping and ACLs; contact info redacted.
- shiftlog samples: entries show rotation commit timestamps and snapshot hashes; hashes are verifiable against the snapshot metadata included.

Secure delivery: If you need the full shiftlog archive rather than samples, we’ll stage a secure SFTP transfer (we prefer to avoid sending full raw logs over email). Please confirm receipt and whether the sampled artifacts are sufficient for the SOC 2 scope. If you want the full archive or a live review with one of our HSM operators, we can schedule a 30–45 minute session next week.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleEphemeralCompendium

Regards,
